resampling: sample episodes with replacement within each task; carry all event-window descendants; pair all arms within each draw
point_aggregation: compute within task, then equal-weight the six task estimates

ncsAURC.coverage_grid: 36 fixed points from 0.10 through 0.90 as stored in ANALYSIS_LOCK.json
ncsAURC.ties: fractional inclusion of the boundary score group
ncsAURC.primary_contrast: lineage_unaware minus acquisition_registered at m=4; positive favors registration

secondary.accuracy: argmax posterior; NOT READY on exact tie
secondary.nll: negative log probability of the reference class, clipped at 1e-12
secondary.brier: sum of squared errors over both binary class probabilities
secondary.ece: 10 equal-count bins of predicted-class confidence versus correctness
secondary.wrong_admission_all: fraction of all records that are wrong within the top 0.13 score coverage
secondary.wrong_admission_conditional: wrong fraction among the top 0.13 score coverage
secondary.budget_ratio: total fused evidence divided by native_one_per_view total evidence on the matched record

reporting.m4: all five arms with point estimates and episode-bootstrap intervals
reporting.checkpoints: 32B primary and 8B replication reported separately; no cross-checkpoint fusion
reporting.failures: all task-level signs and null or adverse results retained

result_prohibitions: no model selection from held-out outcomes
